title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: GAR Resp. 1 — denying death-devotion in Adam's person deserts Confession Art. 10
pass_a_gloss: Garrigues's first reply: anyone who denies we were devoted to death in Adam's person has deserted the churches' Confession, which Art. 10 states expressly.
pass_b_english: GAR. Resp. I. Those who deny that we were devoted to death in Adam's own person plainly desert the Confession of our churches, which teaches and expressly says that in Art. 10.
source_text: GAR. Resp. I. Qui negant nos in ipsa Adami persona fuisse morti addictos, illi manifeste deserunt Confessionem Ecclesiarum nostrarum, quae id docet & dicit expresse Art. 10.
notes: Cap. IX GAR Resp.1 densify section 605 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 347–348 tip).
